sql_templates.name: index_returns
sql_templates.purpose: Calculate index returns over the last 3 months and detect exceptions.
sql_templates.sql: WITH recent_trades AS (SELECT trade_date, index_symbol, close FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'), latest_trade AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS latest_date FROM market.index_eod) SELECT rt.index_symbol, (rt.close - lt.close) / lt.close * 100 AS return_3m FROM recent_trades rt JOIN market.index_eod lt ON rt.index_symbol = lt.index_symbol WHERE lt.trade_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_trade);
